acceptance.1_not_found_states: HumanGateDetail renders detailNotFoundTitle/Body (zh-TW: 找不到收件匣項目) and StrategyDetail renders mgmt.strategy.detailNotFound (zh-TW: 找不到策略) on 404; 5xx and network errors keep the load failure state. Covered by HumanGateDetail.test.tsx and StrategyDetail.spec.test.tsx.
acceptance.2_ranking_formula_detail: RankingFormulaDetail now calls bffV1.rankingFormulas.get(id) (GET /bff/ranking-formulas/{id}) instead of filtering list(); 404 renders 'Ranking Policy Not Found'. Existing list-mocking tests were re-pointed to get (same assertions). New tests assert get called with the id, list not called, and 404 not-found.
acceptance.3_llm_auth_probe: OpenClawLlmAuthPanel.load() only issues authProbe:false reads. The live probe runs through the new 'Check auth now' button (runAuthProbe). With auth_probe:false meta the badge reads 'auth not checked' instead of 'auth ready'. The old test asserting the automatic mount probe was replaced by two tests: no probe on mount, probe only on click.

4_postmortem_first_render.test: PostmortemLibrary.test.tsx 'issues the list read on first render under a production build' stubs PROD/NODE_ENV=production and VITE_BFF_MODE=live, uses the real transport with only fetch stubbed, and asserts a fetch to /api/v1/postmortems on first render.
4_postmortem_first_render.hosted_crawl_cause: The page does issue GET /api/v1/postmortems on first render. scripts/accept-management-hosted-production.mjs isBffUrl() only counts pathnames starting with /bff/ (plus health endpoints), so the /api/v1/postmortems request is never recorded as a BFF request and the crawler reports none. This is a crawler attribution gap, tracked by FE-GATE-CRAWLER-ROUTE-ATTRIBUTION-20261114; no gate script was changed here.

acceptance.5_scope: No release gate script, budget, or rule changed. No test deleted; the only replaced test is the one that asserted the removed mount-time auto probe.
